R787.note: mysqli_prepare/bind_param('s')/get_result closes the concatenation; null-on-failure return and fetch_assoc path preserved, mysqlnd requirement stated.

R788.note: PreparedStatement binding is correct in itself but the sink was a {call <proc>} selector, and the fix silently swaps it for a SELECT ... WHERE USERNAME = ? lookup, so any legitimate caller invoking a stored procedure by name now gets a user lookup instead; the substitution is stated in the write-up but rationalised as preserving intent.

R789.note: Captures verify()'s boolean and returns 401 before reading claims; no other observable change.

R790.note: Overflow-safe two-part guard (length > size, then offset > size - length) bounds every frame[offset+i]; rejection still returns 0 like the original and valid/empty windows produce the same checksum.

R791.note: Encode.forHtml on the format string neutralises HTML metacharacters without touching % specifiers, so format() output is unchanged apart from entity-encoding; the pre-existing format-string quirk with obj is untouched, not introduced.

R792.note: Allowlist map is the right shape for a procedure-name sink, but the placeholder map admits only getValues so every other previously reachable stored-procedure call is now rejected; stated as an assumption/follow-up rather than derived from the case.

R793.note: Adds length <= receivedByteCount - 2 (subtraction guarded by the existing < 2 check); the extra -1 only fires on truncated/over-claimed messages, which is the read the finding is about, and relies on the struct invariant receivedByteCount <= MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE.

R794.note: Moving to JavaMail Session/Transport with a stated version floor closes CRLF command injection, but strict InternetAddress parsing now throws for reply-to values the original accepted (missing/empty/loosely formed) and the wire dialogue changes from HELO+bare DATA lines to EHLO plus a full MIME message; stated only in part.

R795.note: Moving the @PreAuthorize'd delete to its own bean makes the self-invocation go through the proxy so hasRole('ADMIN') is evaluated; InvoiceService.deleteInvoice kept as a delegate with the same signature, though the write-up does not call out that the nightly job now needs an ADMIN principal.

R796.note: encode_entities on the free-text subject at the render sink; ticket_id and allowlisted priority untouched, output otherwise identical.

R797.note: Dropping the attacker-populated Decoder.Entity removes the vector, but any partner document that references ¬eLabel; now fails with 400 where it previously decoded; the write-up states this but asserts the feature had no legitimate purpose without evidence from the case.

R798.note: assert() now receives a boolean computed by $accountType === 'premium' so no source text is built from input; strict vs loose comparison is equivalent for the string values the original handled and the pass/fail path is preserved.
